requirements: docs/24 Cloud API / Postgres / Object storage / Identity / Multi-tenancy
scenarios: cloud API qualification (hosted cloud job: Postgres 16 + MinIO)
proof: the real Cloud API over a real Postgres 16 and a real MinIO: token issuance and refresh rotation with replay revocation; idempotent commands by command_id; the canonical log with the local store's envelope, sequence and hash chain, projections and the command ledger in one transaction; cursor replay and a WSS stream that replays then delivers live with a resume cursor; approvals bound to intent; ranged output reads and signed artifact URLs; tenants never crossing, every attempt audited; generation-fenced session leases; per-principal rate limits.
audit: MISSING before: the M0 skeleton refused to run.
limitations: secret→token identity (no OIDC yet); NoTls to Postgres; handoffs follow; commands for a held session are relayed to its worker (M8.2).
